meta.title: Train Control
meta.author: payne (Brain Control)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Train Control by Brain Control (April 2012). Brain Control's 64K intro that placed 4th in the PC 64K intro competition at Revision 2012. Music by payne (credited in the intro's readme and pouet), made with Tunefish 3, the synthesizer of Brain Control's Enigma Studio 3. 116 BPM, 2:49, 15 tracks, 671 note cells. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the song and its instruments were read from the released executable (tools/tf3-extract: the kkrunchy stub emulated until the intro starts, then the synth block found in the unpacked image; parameters stored percent), converted by `synth-convert e3prj` in player mode to the unified synth (points and PAD table oscillators, Tunefish 3 decimation stage, insert effects as track devices) and imported with `song import` (notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the original Tunefish 3 player it differs by +0.07 dB loudness and at most 0.39 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz; against a capture of the released intro by at most 1.40 dB per octave band. The random per-note detune (slop) is not converted. Track names are derived here from each track's notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while Brain Control is asked for permission, and is removed at the authors' request.
